verdict.rationale: Dagster pipelines are defined as plain Python code (asset definitions, `dg.asset` decorators) scaffolded via CLI into a standard project structure (pyproject.toml, src, tests) that lives in a normal repo, confirmed by hands-on probes showing the CLI scaffolds and runs a project end-to-end. This is inherently version-controllable, code-reviewable, and portable across environments (local, CI, Docker deployment docs confirm portability). missing for 10: no explicit documentation/discussion of git-based review workflows or portability testimonials from independent/community sources beyond docs and CLI probes.
